Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.
